findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_generic_draft_claims, get_case_readiness, get_next_actions · Private data: get_new_beginnings_capabilities, get_procedural_requirements, check_court_document_guardrails, review_generic_draft_claims, get_case_readiness, get_profile · Public sink: get_conversation_continuity_guidance, check_court_document_guardrails, audit_legal_proposition · Destructive: check_court_document_guardrails, audit_legal_proposition.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_generic_draft_claims, get_case_readiness, get_next_actions · Private data: get_new_beginnings_capabilities, get_procedural_requirements, check_court_document_guardrails, review_generic_draft_claims, get_case_readiness, get_profile · Public sink: get_conversation_continuity_guidance, check_court_document_guardrails, audit_legal_proposition · Destructive: check_court_document_guardrails, audit_legal_proposition

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
